title: Agent Hooks — host declaration document (agent-hooks-declaration/1.0)
description: A host declaration document (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §7.7): one JSON object that fixes a host's configuration (§7.1, §8, §10.1, §13.1), its declared surface (§13.1) and its interceptor bindings. The document is a versioned contract of its own, separate from the wire version agent-hooks/0.1 and from package versions; this file describes agent-hooks-declaration/1.0. Every object is closed except bindings[].config and the values under extensions. This schema is self-contained so a settings validator can use it alone. Rules it cannot express (knob consistency, the §3.2 floor, surface against the host's code, registered names) live in the loader (§7.7.6).

$schema.description: Ignored by the loader; kept for editors.

declaration.description: The declaration contract version (§7.7.2). A loader refuses any value outside the set it accepts with declaration_error:version_unsupported. Major 0 is reserved for the conformance kit.

spec.description: OPTIONAL. The wire version the document was written for; the loader's major, and a minor no greater than the loader's. Defaults to the loader's SPEC_VERSION.

id.description: OPTIONAL. An operator label for logs. Never stamped on records.

host.description: OPTIONAL and informative; never checked against code.

on_approval.description: Consulted by sequential/first_deny only; refused under any other profile (§7.7.3).

composition.description: §7.2. A knob the declared profile does not consult is refused, never cleared; a consulted knob left unset takes the §7.2 default.

identity_provider.description: §10.1: "jcs-sha256" (the default), a registered custom provider name (^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$, never a jcs prefix), or null (identity-unbound).

resolver.description: §9. A registered approval resolver by reference, or null: liftable denies stay denies.

redactor.description: §9 redaction seam. A registered approval redactor by reference, or null.

tool_seam_host_error.description: §13.1. Must equal the posture the host's code implements.

interceptor_ms.description: §7 interceptor bound; default 5000. null means unbounded and must be written out.

approval_resolver_ms.description: §9 resolver bound; defaults to the value of interceptor_ms.

max_buffered.description: In-memory record buffer bound; null (the default) is unbounded.

configuration.description: Host configuration (§7.1). Every member is OPTIONAL; defaults are the values the specification already names and fail closed.

interception_points.description: Points the host emits; always includes agent_startup, input, output and agent_shutdown (§3.2), and omits the model or tool points only in pairs.

profiles.description: Profiles and the knob values supported under each (§13.1). Only the knobs a profile consults may appear; an absent knob member means the §7.2 default value only.

buffered_output.description: §12.1a. false must be declared explicitly and requires exposure_bound.

declaration_versions.description: Contract versions the host accepts (§7.7.2); includes the document's own.

surface.description: The declared surface (§13.1) in file form. OPTIONAL: when absent the host's own code surface applies. Every stated member must be a subset of what the host's code reports; a document a conformance claim cites carries this block explicitly.

bindings.description: Ordered: array order is dispatch order. REQUIRED, so an empty-deny host (zero bindings) is written down rather than arrived at by omission. Binding ids are unique.

extensions.description: Host-specific extras, kept verbatim and never read by the loader. Keys follow the §4.6 namespace rule; the §4.6 reserved namespaces apply.

capability.description: The conformance capability vocabulary (§13.1, conformance/vectors.schema.json) less buffered_output, which is the boolean surface member, plus host_declaration.

id.description: Unique in the array; stamped on verdicts[].name (§10.3).

kind.description: A lookup key into the host's kind registry and nothing more: never a path, class name, URL or module the loader interprets. At least one dot, so every kind carries a namespace the host controls. The first segments agent_hooks and ctk are reserved. This specification defines no kinds.

config.description: Kind-specific; handed to the kind resolver unchanged and never read by the loader. Default {}.

at.description: Points this binding runs at, each in the surface. Default: every surface point.

timeout_ms.description: Per-binding bound. Default: configuration.timeouts.interceptor_ms; null is unbounded.
